Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients

Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out 14 oz sweetened condensed milk and 3 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder and 1 tbsp unsalted butter (plus sprinkles for rolling) in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

2

Cook Fudge Until Pan-Pull Stage

Whisk 14 oz sweetened condensed milk, 3 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, and 1 tbsp unsalted butter (plus sprinkles for rolling) in a nonstick saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring constantly for 9–10 minutes until the mixture parts cleanly when you tilt the pan.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Do not rush on high heat—medium-low prevents scorching and builds shiny caramel chew.

3

Roll Into Glossy Truffles

Pour onto a buttered plate, chill 20 mins, then roll into bite-sized balls with lightly buttered hands and coat in chocolate sprinkles.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

4

Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve

Pull the pan off the heat as soon as 3-Ingredient Brazilian Brigadeiro Truffles coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 12 bowls and garnish before serving.

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES115 kcal
SERVINGS12
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep 3-ingredient brazilian brigadeiro truffles in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
